title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base: the SIGTERM exit leaves a ticfac-registry-guard temp tree behind
description:
Running the test alone, with or without GIT_CONFIG isolation, at base cd41beb2 and with this tick's changes, it fails identically: 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<random>]'. The child's registry-guard temp tree under its TMPDIR is not cleaned up on the SIGTERM evacuation path, so every non-short full-suite run (make test) is red on this host. The per-tick gate is unaffected: internal/cli passes under -short.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 0281c58666b57f950421cd9fad36690eaa4337fb55c2c984278427e6bd65090d (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-c2g/attempt-53): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/0281c58666b57f950421cd9fad36690eaa4337fb55c2c984278427e6bd65090d.json on the run branch.
